description: This source file contains a set of shell functions for retrieving and manipulating MAC addresses from various sources and formats, primarily used in embedded Linux/OpenWrt environments. It includes functions for extracting MAC addresses from device trees, JSON configs, MTD partitions, MMC devices, and applying cryptographic decryption. Additionally, it provides utilities for MAC address canonicalization, modification, and random generation.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address label from device tree or JSON configuration.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for a given MTD partition name.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII format from an MTD partition given a key.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from an encrypted MTD partition using specified decryption method.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from an encrypted MTD partition with a different decryption technique.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from a UBI volume via UCI configuration.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Extracts a MAC address in text format from an MTD partition at a specified offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Reads MAC address in ASCII form from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from MMC.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address's NIC part.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the MMC device CID hash.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string with a separator.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address (used for MAC address modifications).

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'local administered' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the 'multicast' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_2bin
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to binary form.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Standardizes and validates a MAC address string.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled (status=okay).
